description: IWEPS WalStat - bâtiments et logements par année de construction et par type is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IWEPS WalStat. Part des bâtiments érigés avant 1900 sur le total des bâtiments. Ces données sont issues de la statistique cadastrale du parc de bâtiments. The 3 datasets in this record: Bâtiments selon l'année de construction de WalStat; Census 2011-2021 Année de construction des logements de WalStat; Types de logements de WalStat. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 3 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Administration et Services publics, Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are logement, bâtiments, statistiques. The portal shows 287 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support building stock, energy use and retrofit studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
